policy.reading: First slash-separated dataset reading; never infer polyphones from hanzi.
policy.segmentation: Tone-marked pinyin lexicon, explicit apostrophe/space/hyphen boundaries, one syllable per hanzi (explicit suffix r consumes 儿). Hanzi heteronyms only disambiguate syllable boundaries, never replace pinyin.
policy.neutral: Unmarked source syllables are tone 5. No dictionary-driven neutralization of explicitly marked lexical tones.
policy.erhua: Only explicit source suffix r becomes model R before tone; separately written ér stays a full syllable.
policy.sandhi: Misaki/PaddleSpeech contextual third-tone word rule and two-pass boundary merging (at most three characters, no reduplication merge), fed authoritative source tones. 不 before citation tone 4 becomes tone 2; A不A and A一A middle is neutral. 一 before tone 4 becomes 2, before tones 1/2/3 becomes 4; ordinal 第一 and numeric sequences retain citation tone.
policy.limits: Isolated vocabulary, not sentence prosody. Source neutral tones preserved, no automatic lexical neutral-tone dictionary. Third-tone phrasing uses deterministic jieba segmentation; not human auditory validated.
